description: Changes a Clio matter's practice area by name, with a stage when that area uses stages. Nothing else changes. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

matter_id.description: Clio matter id (digits) from find_matter or list_open_matters. Not the display number.

practice_area.description: Practice area NAME as it appears in Clio.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

stage.description: Stage NAME in the new practice area. Required when that practice area uses stages.

name: set_matter_practice_area
title: Set matter practice area
